models.M_Z: rel = a + b*Z (OLS over placements; 95% CI from t distribution).
models.M_full: rel = a + b*Z + c*tiltB + d*u_c + e*v_c, u_c,v_c = board-pixel centroid offset from (cx,cy) in units of 100 px; tiltB = 1 for nominal tilt B (measured tilt > 10 deg).
models.M_disp: physical model Z_meas = fB/(fB/Z_true + delta): fit delta (px) by least squares on the per-placement medians; report delta and its 95% CI.

classification (pre-specified, not blind.Z-invariant (B or f scale): b's 95% CI contains 0 and a's excludes 0.
classification (pre-specified, not blind.tilt / image position (residual distorti: partial F-test of (c,d,e) added to M_Z has p < 0.05.
classification (pre-specified, not blind.rule: classes are not exclusive; every class whose rule holds is reported. None hold -> 'not determined'.

1-a_B1_SUJ_live.procedure: ECM retracted; user pushes the PSM1 SUJ a small amount (target >= 10 mm at the SUJ tip), then the ECM SUJ, then returns both. Record the SUJ measured_cp topics for PSM1 and ECM (and PSM1/ECM measured_cp in world) before/during/after at >= 10 Hz.

1-b_local_registration.procedure: r2_tip_session-style robot-driven tip session. >= 30 poses within about 40x40x20 mm around the needle work area on the pad, wrist roll +-60 deg, pitch/yaw +-30 deg. Every automatic trajectory dry-run 20 mm above the pad first.
1-b_local_registration.tip_measurement: same as R2: mean of 10 rect frames, tip clicked on topic-right (physical left), sub-pixel NCC disparity along the epipolar line, serration-aliasing handled as in r2_tip_solve2.py (clear peaks first, ambiguous resolved by the model fitted on clear ones, training poses only).
1-b_local_registration.split: pose ids get a random permutation with numpy default_rng(20260930) BEFORE capture; the first ceil(25%) of planned poses are test. Unusable test poses stay in the test denominator as 'unusable'. Test poses never enter the fit (including the ambiguity-resolution model).
1-b_local_registration.fit: TCP + T_reg jointly, SE(3) and Sim(3), train/holdout RMS and max. TCP compared with R2 (-2.70, 1.08, 23.81) mm.

H_1b.decision: holds iff holdout RMS on the pre-drawn test split < 2.80 mm. The 20-rep random-split distribution is reported as secondary.

1-c_G1_tolerance.change_vs_day1_prereg: offset grid replaced by: radial (in needle plane, perpendicular to arc) {0, +-1, +-2, +-3, +-4} mm; vertical {0, +1, +2, +3} mm; tangential {+-2, +-4} mm. 3 trials per offset; reference (0) grasp repeated 3 times per axis block with the human-repeatability of re-placing the needle reported.
1-c_G1_tolerance.vertical_safety: no offset below the contact with the pad; +k means k mm ABOVE the reference grasp height.
1-c_G1_tolerance.report: success-vs-offset per axis with Wilson CI; largest |delta| with 3/3 on each side of each axis. Descriptive, no prediction (unchanged).

1-d_hover_and_correct.target: grasp point p* in camera frame from the stereo arc fit of the marker point (not FP). FP-target end-to-end block only if the printed tab needle (T-1) exists.
1-d_hover_and_correct.procedure: hover = p* + 10 mm vertically up (up = PSM1 base -z mapped to camera by T_reg rotation; recorded). Open-loop: command hover via T_reg + TCP. Correct: measure the jaw tip p_obs by stereo (same method as 1-b), e = hover - p_obs, command += R_reg^T e (rotation only), then measure again (p_obs2, mandatory). Then descend, close, lift 10 mm, wait 2 s; success = needle still in the jaws.
1-d_hover_and_correct.design: 8 placements (different position/orientation), each with both conditions x 2 trials, order randomised per placement with numpy default_rng(20261001) drawn before the first trial.
1-d_hover_and_correct.metrics: open-loop hover error |hover - p_obs| and corrected |hover - p_obs2| in camera frame, and in PSM base frame via R_reg^T; per placement = mean of its 2 trials.

H_1d.statement: corrected hover error <= 1.5 mm and clearly smaller than open-loop.
H_1d.decision: holds iff median over placements of corrected error <= 1.5 mm AND exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over the 8 placements (corrected vs open-loop) p < 0.05.

1-d_hover_and_correct.grasp_success: paired by (placement, trial index): 16 pairs, exact McNemar; noted that the 2 trials of a placement are not independent.
